scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: Scripps College Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF, Assessment and Institutional Research)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set 2025-26 (fall 2025 entering class): 3,230 applied, 1,288 admitted, 301 enrolled (Scripps is a women's college; the CDS lists 12 male and 1 unknown-gender applicants, 4 male admits). The residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals. International: 449 applied, 81 admitted, 11 enrolled. The ED figure covers both Early Decision plans (275 applications, 141 admitted). Scripps no longer reports high-school GPA (CDS note: "due to the range in types of unweighted scores and the difficulty of standardizing weighted scores"), so there is no GPA data. SAT/ACT submission is optional; 57 enrollees (19%) submitted the SAT and 37 (12%) the ACT, so the score ranges describe a small, self-selected group. Undergraduate enrollment (1,098) is the CDS B2 total of degree-seeking undergraduates and the international count (52) its nonresident degree-seeking undergraduates; all undergraduates incl. non-degree-seeking: 1,103. The student-to-faculty ratio (10 to 1) is printed under the heading "Fall 2024" in this CDS.

cost.notes: Published 2026-27 estimate for full-time, degree-seeking students living in Scripps housing, from Scripps's Tuition and Fees page: tuition and fees $70,926 (billed as $35,300 tuition + $163 student body fee per semester); housing and food $23,848; books and supplies $800; personal expenses $1,500; transportation $500 to $1,500 depending on home location. The page prints a total of $97,574 to $98,574; the lower end is shown. The student health plan ($3,312) and federal loan fees are not included.
